id.description: The auto-generated ID of the system.

lastModified.description: The last time this system was modified.

dataCenterId.description: The ID of the data center the system is located in.

region.description: Region the system is located in.

softwareVersion.description: The version of the tdqg-node package that should be installed on all nodes of the system.

maximumMemoryPerNode.description: The maximum memory per node in bytes allowed to be used by QueryGrid queries.

bridgeOnly.description: Flags if this system is a bridge only system (e.g. no local data source)

proxySupportType.description: Flags if a proxy should be used by this system for connecting to QueryGrid Manager.

proxyPort.description: The port number to listen for proxying connections. Required with LOCAL_PROXY.

proxyNetworkId.description: The UUID of a network rule to specify the network to use to enable proxy support. The default is to use the byn1 network interface automatically.

proxyBridgeId.description: The ID of a remote bridge system (edge nodes) to use to proxy connections to QueryGrid Manager. Bridge system must have proxySupport = LOCAL_PROXY specified.

enableProxy.description: Flags if this system should be directed to run a proxy

enableOverridePort.description: Flags if this system is overriding the fabric TCP server socket.

overridePort.description: The port number for the tdqg-node service to bind to.

autoNodeDelete.description: Flag to enable auto node delete.

autoNodeDeleteMinutes.description: Number of minutes a node is offline before being auto deleted when autoNodeDelete is enabled.

systemType.description: The type of the data source to which the system nodes belong.

systemFlavor.description: The flavor of the Hadoop system.

platformType.description: The platform on which the system is deployed.

tags.description: Optional string key/value pairs for associating some context with the system such as cloud site ID.

nodesOnline.description: The number of nodes online for the system

nodesOffline.description: The number of nodes offline for the system

dataCenterName.description: The name of the data center the system is located in.

lastInstallOperationId.description: The ID of the last auto-install operation performed for the system.

lastInstallStatus.description: The status of the last auto-install operation performed for the system.
